name: fadezy-os
description: FADEZY OS — international multi-tenant SaaS for barbershops and beauty salons

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fadezy/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @fadezy/shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @fadezy/shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fadezy/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
